Q_correctness: Recheck production-specialized Q64/Q128/Q256 with varied signed weights/activation at token,stream,row,block,word granularity; rows1/2/4; check every live and inactive output and each WG epoch/xor/extent. No change to arithmetic or checker tolerance.
norm_lo: Production norm and LO_Q8 shaders with pre-ready generation, resident input and system-memory mailbox variants; verify all outputs and correct bank retirement. Isolated cost excludes host handoff latency and is not hardware lower bound.
resource_model: Use separately measured shader intervals to replace inappropriate generic HC estimates; do not sum overlapping pipeline waits or add timestamp overhead to non-profile service as if intrinsic. Freeze any predictive envelope before using held-out end-to-end timings.
safety: Run after model pilot completion and utility compilation; one exclusive GPU lock and five-card idle, no concurrent compilation. Stop on any numeric/protocol/fence error.
